sourceUnits.zh: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
sourceUnits.en: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while serving as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
sourceUnits.literal: When Duan Liao requested that Jilong receive him, Yu, as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.

sourceUnits.zh: 秋敗，裕為軍人所執，將詣皝。
sourceUnits.en: Ma Qiu’s defeat left Yang Yu a prisoner on his way to Murong Huang.
sourceUnits.literal: When Qiu was defeated, Yu was seized by soldiers, was about to be brought to Huang.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝素聞裕名，即命釋其囚，拜郎中令，遷大將軍左司馬。
sourceUnits.en: Murong Huang, who had long heard of Yu’s name, at once ordered his bonds released, appointed him Palace Director, then promoted him to Grand General’s Left Major.
sourceUnits.literal: Huang had long heard of Yu’s name; immediately ordered his bonds released; appointed Palace Director; promoted him to Grand General’s Left Major.

sourceUnits.zh: 東破高句麗，北滅宇文歸，皆豫其謀，皝甚器重之。
sourceUnits.en: He helped plan the eastern victory over Goguryeo and the northern destruction of Yuwen Gui, and Huang came to rely on him heavily.
sourceUnits.literal: East defeated Goguryeo, north destroyed Yuwen Gui—both he pre-planned their strategies; Huang greatly prized and employed him.

sourceUnits.zh: 及遷都和龍，裕雅有巧思，皝所制城池宮闔，皆裕之規模。
sourceUnits.en: When the capital shifted to Helong, Yang Yu’s engineering shaped every wall and tower Murong Huang built.
sourceUnits.literal: When moved the capital to Helong, Yu by nature had clever thought; the city walls and palace towers Huang regulated were all Yu’s models.

sourceUnits.zh: 裕雖仕皝日近，寵秩在舊人之右，性謙恭清儉，剛簡慈篤，雖曆居朝端，若布衣之士。
sourceUnits.en: Although Yang Yu served Huang and grew daily closer, with favor and rank above the old retainers, his nature was humble, respectful, pure and frugal, firm, simple, kind and earnest; though he repeatedly held posts at the apex of the court, he was like a scholar in plain cloth.
sourceUnits.literal: Although Yu served Huang daily nearer, favor and rank above the old men’s, nature humble and respectful, clear and frugal, firm, simple, kind, and earnest; although passed through dwelling at court’s apex, like a scholar in plain cloth.

sourceUnits.zh: 士大夫流亡羈絕者，莫不經營收葬，存恤孤遺，士無賢不肖皆傾身待之，是以所在推仰。
sourceUnits.en: He buried exiles, aided their orphans, and honored every gentleman he met, winning universal esteem.
sourceUnits.literal: Grandees and scholars who fled in exile and were cut off—none he did not arrange burial for, preserve and pity orphans left behind; gentry whether worthy or not all he inclined his person to treat; therefore wherever he was was pushed and looked up to.

sourceUnits.zh: 初，范陽盧諶每稱之曰：「吾及晉之清平，曆觀朝士多矣，忠清簡毅，篤信義烈，如陽士倫者，實亦未幾。」
sourceUnits.en: Earlier, Lu Chen of Fanyang always praised him, saying, “I have lived through Jin’s clear peace and have broadly observed many court gentlemen; loyal, pure, concise and resolute, steadfast in faith and fierce in righteousness—men like Yang Shilun are in truth few.”
sourceUnits.literal: In the beginning, Fan Yang’s Lu Chen always praised him, saying: “I have reached Jin’s clear peace, broadly viewed many court gentlemen; loyal, pure, concise, resolute, faithful in duty and fierce in righteousness—like Yang Shilun, in truth also not many.”

sourceUnits.zh: 及死，皝甚悼之，時年六十二。
sourceUnits.en: When he died at sixty-two, Murong Huang mourned him deeply.
sourceUnits.literal: When he died, Huang greatly mourned him; at the time age sixty-two sui.
